title: PKI parity deepening: CA metadata + certificate revoke/ACME options
acceptance_criteria: PKI UI supports CA fields: certificate, CRL, description, private key, and private password-protected flag.
PKI UI supports certificate fields: certificate, description, private key, private password-protected, revoke, and ACME metadata.
ACME metadata includes domain-name list, email, listen-address, rsa-key-size, and URL with diff-based set/delete operations.
Frontend validation passes: tsc, lint (0 errors), build, runtime smoke, and browser smoke.
assumptions: PKI values are entered as single-line strings compatible with VyOS CLI command arguments.
No backend API changes are required because existing `/vyos/pki/*` config-tree wrapper already supports scoped batch commands.
Unrelated dirty files in this worktree remain untouched.

tasks.notes: Mapped PKI cfgcmd coverage to form fields based on docs: CA metadata and certificate ACME/revoke options.
Implemented form-first PKI editor with additional toggles and ACME controls.
No backend changes; preserved existing API contracts and wrapper behavior.
Validated compile/build/runtime/browser smoke; no new unit tests added for UI-only command-diff logic.
Manual reviewer pass completed; no blocking issues found.
